title: SecurityEvent
description: A security event emitted by the Intriqo IDS engine. This is the canonical cross-boundary contract between the C++ engine and the Python control plane / agent platform.

event_type.description: Detector-specific event type literal. Python consumers map this via EVENT_TYPE_MAP.

severity.description: Severity classification assigned by the detector.

source_address.description: Source IP address of the suspicious traffic.

destination_address.description: Destination IP address of the suspicious traffic.

details.description: Detector-specific metadata (e.g. port counts, thresholds). Optional.
